$comment: Runtime images Runpool creates containers from, pinned by digest.
A tag can move; a digest cannot, so a release always runs the images
it was tested against. The runner and dind pair is reviewed together:
a job's docker client and daemon both come from the dind image, whose
/usr/local/bin precedes the Docker the runner image keeps in /usr/bin.
internal/qualification/cmd/image-lock re-resolves each tag and fails
when a digest has drifted from what is recorded here. It runs on
every pull request and again inside the qualification.
platforms are what a release builds for, which is not what it
qualifies: build/platform.lock.json records the platforms the suites
were run on, and neither list promises the other. The digests need no
per-platform variant because they are index digests already: a build
targeting one of these resolves that platform's child of the same

runner.note: GitHub requires a runner with auto-update disabled to be updated within 30 days of a release.

dind.note: Runs privileged inside the capsule; its data root is a fresh volume per job. Release qualification exercises this exact digest through the capsule candidate.
